name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Ordering & kitchen for food trucks
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, keep the kitchen from being overloaded with orders and keep selling when the signal drops. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen-management app for food trucks: the tool your team runs the trading shift with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm the dishes the kitchen can make, then mark the order ready and collected by the customer.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T MAKE
Set how much the kitchen can make at once and the time it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it, so the queue always matches the kitchen’s strength.

TAKE ORDERS RIGHT AT THE TRUCK
Add on-the-spot orders to the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows the dishes to make now, the next ones and the finished ones, with an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect the kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SELLING WHEN THE SIGNAL DROPS
Switch on offline protection: if the connection is lost, pre-ordering pauses so nobody places an order you can’t see. Orders you take on the device are saved and synced when the network is back.

DESIGNED FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen always on during the shift, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WHOLE WEEK
Set up events and locations once, then take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
